signal_contract.decision_time: signal M15 bar completion equal to next M15 boundary

execution_contract.entry: first executable source-native Tick timestamp >= decision_time
execution_contract.exit_boundary: decision/entry M15 boundary plus exactly 12 completed M15 bars (3 hours)
execution_contract.exit: first executable source-native Tick timestamp >= exit_boundary
execution_contract.spread: source-native executable Bid/Ask; MT4 source-native spread or explicitly frozen tester spread
execution_contract.slippage: measured and reported; no event selection by slippage or delay

suppression_contract.active_position_suppression: variant-local; reject signal index i when i <= prior accepted signal index + 13
suppression_contract.opposite_side_same_day: permitted only when not blocked by active-position suppression
suppression_contract.duplicate_handling: duplicate event identity is a blocking technical mismatch
suppression_contract.fold_boundary: reject when signal and frozen exit boundary are not in the same half-year fold during 2023-2024 reproduction

same_timestamp_order: process matured owned exits at the first executable Tick
complete and evaluate the newly closed M15 signal bar
apply candidate-local suppression and ownership restoration
open accepted candidate at the same first executable Tick
chronology_contract.history_policy: required signal, entry or exit history unavailable => unresolved technical mismatch
chronology_contract.restart_restoration: restore open owned position, latest accepted same-day/side state, and pending exit boundary from orders and persisted candidate state

contract_digest_basis: UTF-8 JSON committed before candidate-specific 2025H1 access
